categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Easpring Material Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: lithium-ion battery cathode materials and intelligent equipment. The lithium battery materials segment focuses on the research, production, and sales of multi-element materials, lithium iron phosphate, cobalt lithium, and precursor materials used in power, energy storage, and consumer markets. The intelligent equipment segment, through its subsidiary Zhongding High-Tech, develops and sells high-end intelligent manufacturing equipment and core control components, serving industries such as consumer electronics, medical, packaging, and flexible circuits.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including multi-element spherical precursor co-precipitation, uniform lithiation and crystallization, multi-element co-doping modification, and multi-layer surface/interface modification. It has developed a full lifecycle R&D and formula management system (PLM) for online management of technical indicators, progress, quality, and cost. Production employs lean manufacturing with digital and intelligent integration, including MES, CRM, SRM, and PLM systems for real-time monitoring and flexible scheduling. The intelligent equipment segment uses proprietary motion control software and AI-based visual inspection systems for defect detection and automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Easpring serves global high-end battery manufacturers and automotive OEMs, including LG Energy Solution, SK on, Samsung SDI, Murata, and major international automakers such as Volkswagen, BMW, Daimler, and Hyundai. Domestically, it supplies leading Chinese new energy vehicle and battery companies like BYD, CATL, EVE Energy, and Hive Energy. The products cater to power batteries for electric vehicles, energy storage systems, and consumer electronics markets. The intelligent equipment business serves international consumer electronics brands including Samsung, Apple, Huawei, and Xiaomi.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with production bases in Jiangsu, Changzhou, and Panzhihua, and has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and projects in Hong Kong, Luxembourg, and Finland. Its customer base spans China, South Korea, Japan, Europe, Southeast Asia, and South Asia. The European new materials industrial base in Finland is under construction to serve local and global markets. The company also actively participates in global supply chains and resource procurement.
categories.supply_chain_position: Easpring operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of cathode materials and precursor chemicals. It also extends upstream through strategic partnerships and investments in raw material suppliers for nickel, cobalt, lithium, and phosphate to secure stable and cost-effective supply. Downstream, it collaborates closely with battery manufacturers and automotive OEMs. The intelligent equipment segment supports manufacturing automation within the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with a comprehensive R&D system comprising multiple specialized institutes focusing on high-energy battery materials, new lithium battery materials, and intelligent manufacturing technologies. Key R&D directions include high-nickel multi-element materials, lithium manganese iron phosphate, cobalt lithium, solid-state lithium battery materials, spinel cathode materials, lithium-rich manganese-based materials, and sodium-ion battery cathode materials. It prioritizes product performance upgrades, safety, and cost reduction, while accelerating the industrialization of next-generation battery materials and intelligent equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Easpring generates revenue primarily through direct sales of lithium-ion battery cathode materials and intelligent manufacturing equipment. The sales model is predominantly direct sales, with a focus on high-end differentiated products and strategic customer partnerships. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance domestically and upon customs clearance for exports. The company also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Easpring is positioned as a global leader in lithium-ion battery cathode materials, especially in high-nickel and lithium iron phosphate segments. It competes with major international and domestic battery material suppliers such as CATL, LG Chem, and other specialized cathode material manufacturers. Its intelligent equipment subsidiary competes in the high-end automation equipment market serving consumer electronics and battery manufacturing sectors. The company maintains competitive advantages through technological innovation, strategic supply chain integration, and global market expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Easpring reported total revenue of approximately RMB 7.59 billion, with lithium battery materials accounting for 97.94% of revenue. The company experienced a revenue decline of about 49.8% year-over-year due to slower growth in overseas new energy vehicle markets and intensified competition. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 471.83 million, down 75.48% from the previous year. Despite the downturn, operating cash flow increased by 30.74%. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures of RMB 370 million in 2024, representing 4.88% of revenue. It has a strong asset base with total assets exceeding RMB 17 billion and maintains a healthy liquidity position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Easpring emphasizes its technological leadership and comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple cathode material chemistries, including high-nickel, lithium iron phosphate, and next-generation solid-state and sodium-ion materials. It offers high-performance, high-safety, and cost-effective battery materials tailored to diverse applications such as electric vehicles, energy storage, and consumer electronics. The company’s integrated R&D and production capabilities, combined with strategic supply chain partnerships and global footprint, enable it to provide reliable, innovative, and customized solutions that meet evolving customer demands and industry standards.
